Question: Asak, I am staying at Hyderabad,india My question is as follows: I am an Engg graduate 2005 passout,I am currently working as Asst.Professor i would likely to work in Software industry,But s/w industries wanted experience persons,but i have 2 years of teaching exp. Can i put fake exp. to Get a job in S/w indstry.If yes plz tell what are the possible things need to fullfill(Quaffara),I primay aim is to satisfy me parents their ambition is to See as S/W engg not Teaching profession. So many of my friends are got jobs my putting fake exp they are suggesting me to do so. Answer ID: 3600 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 642/486=H) It is unlawful to show a false experience certificate. The suggestion from friends is also not right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
